tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i 'khrid yig snying bo'i don bsdus pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/
༄༅/ /byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i 'khrid yig snying bo'i don bsdus pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i 'khrid yig snying bo'i don bsdus pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/

bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /'dir byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i dmar 'khrid kyi don bsdus te stan thog gcig la bshar bsgom gyi tshul du nyams su len pa la/ sbyor dngos mjug gsum las/ dang po ni/ gnas gtsang mar rten gyi drung du mchod pa bshags pa sogs byas la/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar byon nas bzhugs par mos te/ bsam pa thag pa nas ngag tu/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub snying bo la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ / 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes ci nus brjod pa'i mjug tu/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la skyabs su mchi'o/ khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud la skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa myur du skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes ci nus kyi mthar/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ /de'i ched du skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa rnams nyams su blangs bar bgyi'o/ /zhes pa lan gsum brjod/ yang na skyabs sems spyi ltar bya/ de nas bla ma bsten pa la bsam sbyor gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rang la chos 'brel yod pa'i bla ma gang yin gsal btab nas/ de la skyon rtog gi blo 'gog ci thub dang*/ yon tan dang bka' drin dran pa'i dad pa ci skye bya ste/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba bla mar gsungs pas/ de'i skyon gyi ngos nas brtags shing ma dad na dngos grub mi 'byung bar ma zad/ ngan 'gror skye ba'i nyes dmigs dang*/ dad cing gus na rang la legs tshogs thams cad 'byung ba rten 'brel gyi chos nyid yin pas

so/ /snyam du bsam zhing ji ltar 'tshams pa zhig dran nas dpyad bsgom bya/ sbyor bas bsten pa ni/ bla ma de dag la dngos su lus ngag gis bsnyen bkur bya dgos na'ang*/ rang nyid gcig pu lta bus nyams su len pa'i tshe lag len du dmigs pas bya ba ni/ mdo phyogs kho na dang bstun pa rgyal dbang gi man ngag bzhin 'khrid yig logs su bkod pa ltar la/ 'dir rang dang skal ba mnyam pa 'ga' zhig gi don du tshogs zhing sngags phyogs spyi dang mthun par mdor bsdus brjod pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i dbyings su seṅge'i khri padma dang zla ba'i gdan la bcom ldan 'das dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa sku gser btso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas sa gnon dang*/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya'i steng na bdud rtsis gang ba'i lhung bzed bsnams pa/ mtshan dpes spras shing sku la chos gos rnam gsum gsol ba/ 'od kyi phung bo'i dbus na zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas su pad zla'i gdan rnams la rim par byams mgon la sogs pa rgya chen spyod brgyud dang*/ g.yon du pad zla'i gdan rnams la rim par 'jam dbyangs la sogs pa zab mo lta brgyud/ steng gi char pad zla'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma dang ngo bo dbyer mi byed pa'i rje btsun chos kyi rgyal bo btsong kha ba/ de rnams kyi rgyab phyogs dang mtha' skor du rang rang gi gdan la bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems sogs kyi tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor nas bzhugs pa de rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ de las 'od zer 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas thub pa'i dbang bo la rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang rgyal ba sras bcas kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ ma lus sems can sogs gcig dang thugs rje'i bdag nyid sogs kyi mthar/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur bar bsam/ gal te sngags phyogs su sbyor mi 'dod na ni 'di ltar/

mchog gsum rgyal ba sras bcas bden byin dang*/ /tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs chos dbyings dag pa'i mthus/ /zhing 'di bde ba can ltar snod bcud kyi/ /'byor ldan mchod tshogs rgya mtshos khyab gyur cig /der ni seng khri rim par 'khod pa'i steng*/ /thub dbang mi pham 'jam pa'i dbyangs la sogs/ /rgya chen zab mo'i brgyud rim bla ma rnams/ /bzhugs nas mchod sprin kun nas spyod gyur cig /ces bya zhing 'di ltar na 'og tu 'od zer 'phro sbyangs tsam byas na bde/ de nas/ rnam dag chos dbyings ma dang*/ ma lus sems can ma dang*/ chos rnams rang bzhin sogs kyis spyan 'dren bya/ /snga phye gang byed kyang*/ /ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis khrus gsol/ stong gsum kun du sogs kyis dri byug /srab 'jam yang ba sogs kyis gos 'bul/ bdag dang 'gro la sogs kyis brtan bzhugs bya/ /de nas yan lag bdun pa bya ba la/ phyag 'tshal ba ni/ phun tshogs dge legs bye bas bskrun pa'i sku nas mar me mdzad la 'dud/ /zhes pa'i bar dang*/ dmigs med brtse ba'i sogs dang*/ zab mo lta ba'i brgyud sogs dang*/ mgon po thugs rje sogs dang*/ ji snyed su dag nas/ bstod ces pa'i bar dang*/ phyag byar 'os pa sogs kyis phyag 'tshal/ me tog dam pa sogs kyis bla na yod med kyi mchod pa dang*/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i gang mos bya/ bsdu na/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na/ /mchod tshogs ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas la/ /'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ zhes sogs lta bu ci rigs kyis mchod pa dang*/ maṇḍal rgyas bsdus gnyis sam gang rung dang*/ /yang na bdag gzhan lus ngag yid gsum sogs kyis maṇḍal 'bul/ 'dod chags zhe sdang sogs dang*/ bshags pa'i tshe gzhan gyis kyang sdig bshags byar rung*/ de nas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba nas/ byang chub chen por bsngo/ zhes pa'i bar gyis yan lag lhag ma rnams bya/ de nas 'dren pa mnyam med ston pa bcom ldan 'das sogs dang*/

smra ba zla med nas rje'i bar gyi gsol 'debs dang*/ de nas/ mkhas grub chen po shes rab seṅge'i zhabs/ /dge 'dun grub dang nor bzang rgyas tsho'i dpal/ /dge 'dun rgya mtsho dge legs dpal bzang bo/ /bsod nams dpal bzang zhabs la= /bsod nams rgya mtsho chos dpal bzang bo dang*/ /dpal 'byor rnam gnyis blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /sbyin pa rgya mtsho blo gros gzhan phan pa/ /rje btsun blo bzang sbyin par gsol ba 'debs/ /rab 'byams gsung rab sogs dang*/ /ston pa sangs rgyas rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /sogs dang*/ rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab nas/ /yon tan gzhir gyur ma'am/ 'jig rten dge legs ma gang rung bya/ shin tu bsdus na 'dir 'od dang bdud rtsi 'bebs sbyangs bya zhing*/ mthar de rnams 'od zhu byas nas rang la bstim/ cung zad rgyas par na/ thub pa'i dbang bo la sogs pa bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad la gus pas gsol ba 'debs so/ khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud la nges 'byung byang chub kyi sems yang dag pa'i lta ba dang pha rol tu phyin pa drug la sogs pa lam gyi rim pa mtha' dag myur du skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum sogs gsol ba drag tu gdab/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ skyes bu chung ngu dang thun mong ba/ 'bring dang thun mong ba/ chen po'i lam gyi rim pa la blo sbyong ba byin rlabs zhu ba'i tshul du gsol 'debs byed pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir tshigs bcad du bya ba la/ thog mar bla ma'i brten tshul la yang bsdus na/ de ltar mchod cing gus pas gsol btab mthus/ /'di'i phyir phan bde'i 'byung gnas bla ma la/ /ma dad log par lta ba gtan spangs nas/ dad gus shugs drag skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /shin tu rnyed dka' rnyed na don che ba'i/ /dal brgyad 'byor bcu tshang ba'i rten 'di nyid/ /yid bzhin nor bu bas kyang dkon mthong nas/

/don chen snying bo len par = /de tshe mi rtag nges par 'chi ba dang*/ /nam 'chi cha med shi tshe chos ma gtogs/ /gang gis kyang ni mi phan rab shes pa'i/ /long med rgyud la= /shi yang las gnyis lus dang grib ma bzhin/ / rjes su 'brang phyir gal te mi dge ba'i/ /las kyi dbang gis ngan 'gror skyes gyur na/ /sdug bsngal myong tshul dran par= /'og gzhi thams cad lcags kyi sa gzhi dang*/ /logs rnams lcags kyi ra ba rab 'bar zhing*/ /phyogs mtshams me lce 'khrigs pas cher gzir pa'i/ /tsha dmyal sdug bsngal dran par= /yang sos thig nag bsdus 'joms ngu 'bod dang*/ /ngu 'bod chen po tsha dang rab tsha ba/ / mnar med tsha dmyal brgyad rnams so so yi/ /sdug bsngal khyad par dran par= / 'og gzhi kha ba'i thang dang 'khyags rong zab/ /mtha' kun gangs ri'i khor yug mun btib par/ kha ba rlung gi bu yug cher 'tshub pa'i/ /grang dmyal sdug bsngal dran par= /chu bur can dang brdol dang a chu zer/ /kyi hud so tham utpal ltar gas dang*/ /padma padma che ltar rab gas pa'i/ /so so'i sdug bsngal dran par= / 'dod pa'i dngos po ci yang med pa yi/ /shin tu nyam nga'i gnas su mi sdug gzugs/ /bkres shing skoms pas rab gzir nyam thag pa'i/ /yi dwags sdug bsngal dran par= /zas skom mi rnyed rnyed kyang spyod mi nus/ /zos 'thung me 'bar 'tshig cing rang sha za/ /rnag khrag la sogs mi gtsang dngos po kun/ /za ba'i sdug bsngal dran par= /mi shes kun du rmongs pa'i sems ldan pas/ / legs nyes blang dor 'byed pa'i mthu med cing*/ /phan tshun gcig gis gcig gsod za ba sogs/ /dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal dran par= /mun nag 'thib por rang gi yan lag dag /brkyangs bskum mi mthong mnan dang khyur mid dam/ / lus 'bug khur bkal bcings shing brdegs pa dang*/ /gsod pa'i sdug bsngal dran pa= /gang tshe shi nas ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal kun/ /rang gis myong bar 'gyur ba'i tshul bsams te/

/de las skyob pa'i skyabs gnas mchog gsum por/ /re bltos shugs drag skye bar= /de ltar skyabs su song yang las gnyis la/ /blang dor phyin ci log tu rab spyad na/ /skyob par mi 'gyur ngan 'gror ltung ba'i phyir/ /dkar po'i las kun bsgrub par= /srog gcod ma byin len dang log par g.yem/ /rdzun dang phra ma tshig rtsub ngag kyal dang*/ /brnab sems gnod sems log lta bcu spangs nas/ /dge bcu tshul bzhin bsgrub par= / gal te bag med nyon mongs rkyen dbang gis/ /mi dge'i las la zhugs par gyur ba na/ /rnam smin sdug bsngal myong ba'i tshul bsams te/ /stobs bzhi'i bshags sdom byed par= /gnyis pa 'bring dang thun mong ba ni/ de ltar bsgrubs pas mngon mtho'i go 'phang tsam/ /rnyed kyang yang dag nyid du bde med cing*/ / sdug bsngal las ni ma 'das shes gyur nas/ /thar 'dod shugs drag skye bar= / de tshe skye rga na 'chi mi sdug 'phrad/ /sdug pa dang bral mi 'dod thog tu bab/ / 'dod pa btsal kyang ma rnyed mya ngan sogs/ /mi yi sdug bsngal dran par= /lha min 'thab rtsod rkyen gyis lus bcad dral/ /'dod lha 'chi ltas rnam lnga 'byung ba dang*/ /gong ma'i lha rnams 'du byed sdug bsngal gyis/ /bcings pa'i tshul rnams dran par= /mdor na khams gsum 'khor ba gang skyes kyang*/ /sdug bsngal gsum po gang yang rung ba yis/ /gzir las ma 'das de phyir 'khor ba las/ /thar 'dod nges 'byung skye bar= /sdug bsngal bskyed pa'i rgyu ni kun 'byung ste/ /gtso bo lta ba lnga dang lta min lnga/ /ngos bzung shes nas spong bar 'dod pa yi/ /don gnyer chen po skye bar= /'dod chags khong khro nga rgyal ma rig pa/ /the tshom 'jig lta mthar lta log par lta/ /lta ba mchog dang tshul zhugs mchog 'dzin gyi/ /nyon mongs bcu spong nus par= /ma rig 'du byed rnam shes ming dang gzugs/ /skye mched reg tshor sred len srid pa dang*/

/skye dang rga shi yan lag bcu gnyis kyis/ /'khor bar 'khor tshul shes par= /'khor ba'i 'jug rim legs par shes byas nas/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab bslab pa gsum/ /nyams su blangs te thar ba'i go 'phang mchog /'thob phyir brtson pas 'jug par= /gsum pa skyes bu chen po ni/ de ltar 'bad pas thar pa tsam thob kyang*/ /rang gzhan don gnyis rdzogs par mi nus pas/ /theg pa chen por 'jug pa'i sgo gcig bu/ /byang chub sems mchog bskyed par= /de tshe sems can mar shes drin dran dang*/ /drin gzo byams pa snying rje lhag bsam drug / goms par byas nas byang chub sems nyid la/ /myong ba tshul bzhin thon par= / sems can rnams la bde dge gtong ba dang*/ /de yi sdug bsngal rang la len 'dod pa'i/ /gtong len tshul bzhin spel ba'i thabs mkhas kyis/ /bdag gzhan mnyam brje nus par= /byang chub sems la tshul bzhin goms byas kyang*/ /rgyal sras spyod pa'i gnas la ma zhugs na/ /rdzogs byang thob par mi nus shes gyur te/ /phyin drug spyod la 'jug par= /zang zing chos dang mi 'jigs sbyin pa rnams/ /sems can rang rang 'dod pa'i dngos ji bzhin/ / bsgyur nas ma chags gtong ba'i blo gros gyis/ /sbyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs par= /nyes spyod kun sdom dge chos sdud pa dang*/ /sems can don byed tshul khrims rnam pa gsum/ /ji bzhin bsrung ba'i tshul la rab 'bad pas/ /tshul khrims phar phyin rdzogs par= /gnod par byed pa'i rkyen la mi khro zhing*/ /sdug bsngal byung ba yid kyis dang du len/ /chos la nges sems legs par goms pa yis/ /bzod pa'i phar phy-in rdzogs par= /sems can re re'i phyir yang grangs med pa'i/ /bskal bar byang chub phyir du slob dgos kyang*/ /mi skyo dge chos sems can don bsgrub pa'i/ /brtson 'grus phar phyin rdzogs par= /dge ba'i dmigs pa dag la rtse gcig pa'i/ /ting 'dzin lus sems bde bar gnas pa dang*/

/yon tan mngon grub sems can don byed pa'i/ /bsam gtan phar phyin rdzogs par= /brtags pa'i dngos po chos kun rnam 'byed pa'i/ /ji lta ji snyed rtogs pa'i shes rab dang*/ /gzhan don tshul bzhin rab tu sgrub byed pa'i/ / shes rab phar phyin rdzogs par= /phung po'i steng du btags tsam ma yin par/ /gang la'ang ma bltos nga zhig rang ngos nas/ /grub grub 'dra ba 'char ba'i tshul shes te/ /thog mar dgag bya nges par= /de nas nga de lus sems 'di gnyis dang*/ /gcig gam tha dad gang rung yin dgos par/ /thag chod phung gsum med par rtogs pa yis/ khyab pa ji bzhin nges par= /de 'dra'i nga de lus sems gnyis ka dang*/ /gcig na lus sems nga gsum cha med kyi/ / gcig tu 'gyur phyir so sor med thal bas/ /bden pa'i gcig bral nges par= /tha dad na yang lus sems so so ru/ /phye ba'i 'og tu nga zhig yod dgos na/ /de ni sus kyang bstan du med pa'i phyir/ /bden pa'i du bral nges par= /de ltar gnad bzhi'i dpyad pa la brten nas/ /phung po'i steng du btags pa tsam yin pa'i/ /nga de gtan nas med par nges pa yi/ /bdag med gnas lugs rtogs par= /de bzhin mgo sogs yan lag lnga yi steng*/ /lus zhes rtog pas btags tsam ma yin par/ /yan lag kun la bltos med tshugs se ba'i/ / lus nyid med par rtogs par= /de ltar chos rnams kun kyang rang rang gi /cha shas sogs la brten nas btags pa las/ /gzhan du grub pa cung zad med rtogs nas/ /rtse gcig mnyam par 'jog par= /de las langs tshe gzugs sogs ji snyed chos/ /rang bzhin med kyang sgyu ma rmi lam ltar/ /snang stong zung du 'jug par nges rnyed nas/ /nyams len snying bor byed par= /sbyin dang snyan par smra dang don mthun dang*/ /don spyod bsdu ba rnam bzhis gzhan gyi don/ /tshul bzhin sgrub par byed pa'i spyod pa yis/ /rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis rlobs/

/de ltar gus pas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /skyabs gnas rnams kyi sku las 'od zer dang*/ /bdud rtsi'i tshogs byung rang gi gnas rnams su/ / zhugs nas sdig sgrib nyes ltung ma lus sbyangs/ /dgyes bzhin bdag gi spyi bor byon nas kyang*/ /'od kyi phung bor gcig 'dres thim pa yis/ /skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa rnams/ /rgyud la skye ba'i nus ldan byin brlabs gyur/ /ces dmigs pa dang bcas te shugs drag tu gsol ba gdab/ /tshigs bcad 'di gnyis gong gi shin tu bsdus pa byed pa'i mthar yang rung*/ /tshogs zhing sngags phyogs la mi sbyor na/ /sku las 'od zer tshogs dkar gsal chem phyung zhes pa lam 'od zhu byed mi byed kyang 'dam ka'o/ /de nas cung zad mnyam par bzhag ste/ dal 'byor gyi rten 'di rnyed par dka' 'o snyam du cung zad cig bsam/ de nas ngan song gi sdug bsngal snyed nas dran par byas la/ /bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyang tshe rabs kun tu ngan song ngan 'gro log par ltung ba'i skye gnas thams cad las thar bar gyur cig /thar na ci ma rung thar bar bdag gis bya'o/ /snyam du bsam zhing lan 'ga' brjod/ /de nas 'khor ba sbyin dang bye brag gi sdug bsngal dran par byas te/ /bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyang mi 'dod bzhin du skye gnas gang du nying 'tshams sbyor ba'i 'khor ba'i rgud pa kun las grol bar gyur cig /grol na ci ma rung sogs sngar bzhin dang*/ de nas ma sogs sems can thams cad mdun du gsal btab la/ sna bug gi rlung phyir bus pa dang mnyam du rang gi bde dge thams cad 'od zer dkar bo'i rnam par rlung la zhon te rang gi sna bug g.yas nas thon/ sems can thams cad kyi sna bug g.yon nas zhugs pas de rnams bde sang sang song bar bsam zhing ngag tu /sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan par gyur cig /ldan na ci ma rung ldan par bdag gis bya'o snyam du bsams nas lan gsum sogs brjod de byams pa bsgom/

yang rang gi sna bug nas rlung rngub pa dang mnyam du sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sdug bsngal thams cad rlung dang 'grogs nas 'od zer nag po'i rnam par de rnams kyi sna bug g.yas nas thon/ rang gi sna bug g.yon nas zhugs te snying dkar nag phung nger byung bar bsams la/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral bar gyur cig bral na ci ma rung sogs/ sngar bzhin brjod cing bsams la snying rje shugs drag tu bsgom/ de nas bdag sogs sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral nas gtan gyi bde ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig /thob na ci ma rung zhes sogs sngar bzhin brjod cing bsams la sems skyed par bya'o/ /de nas yang*/ bdag gis tshe rabs kun du'ang sbyin sogs pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang bsdu ba rnam bzhi sogs rgyal sras kyi spyod pa mtha' dag la legs par slob par gyur cig /slob na ci ma rung bslab par bdag gis bya'o/ /zhes bsam zhing brjod/ de nas zhi gnas kyi phyogs bsgom pa yod na de dang*/ med kyang lta ba'i skor la gnad bzhi'i dpyad pa byed pa'am/ bsdu na 'di ltar gdags gzhi sa rdo shing sogs du ma 'dus pa la brten nas mtho yor ram khang ba zhes sgyu ma bzhin rtog pas phar btags tsam zhig glo bur du byung yang dpyad pa'i tshe sa rdo shing sogs re re nas mtho yor ram khang ba min la/ de rnams las ngo bo tha dad par rang dbang thub pa'i de dag kyang bzhag tu med pa ltar/ gzugs sogs phung bo lnga tshogs rgyun gyi steng du nga'o zhes 'byung yang*/ nga de ni phung bo lnga tshogs pa'i gdags gzhi'i steng du ming brda'am rtog pas bzhag pa tsam las/ gzugs sogs phung bo lnga'i ya gyal re re dang tshogs pa dang rgyun gang yang nga min la/ de rnams la ngo bo tha dad pa'i nga yang med pas na nga de phung bo'i steng du rang dbang thub pa'i tshul gyis med do/ /de'i phyir nga ni rang bzhin gyis grub pa med snyam du dpyad bsgom bya/

de las langs pa'i tshe de lta na'ang me long ngos su shar ba'i gzugs brnyan ltar tha snyad tsam du bya byed thams cad 'thad pa'o snyam du snang stong tshogs pa la nges pa drang bar bya'o/ /gsum pas mjug tu dge ba rnams rdzogs byang du bsngo'o/ /dmigs skor phyi ma 'di rnams khyad che yang*/ ma lcogs na gong du 'od zhu byas pa'i mthar bsngo smon bya'o/ /'dir tshogs zhing sngags phyogs la brten pa tsam byas pa ni 'gal ba med par ma zad/ phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur ba'i phyir na/ blo gsal ba dag mthong rgya chung ba'i rtags ma ston cig /ces pa 'di ni rang gi slob ma rnam dpyod dang ldan pa'i gnas brtan chos rin chen gyis nye bar bskul zhing*/ khyad par du lha ris sogs bzo rigs pa'i gnas la blo gros rnam par phyogs pa'i dge slong ngag dbang dpal 'byor gyis gzhan la phan thogs par 'gyur srid snyam ste/ rang nyid kyi chos skal du dad pas kun nas bslangs nas par du bsgrub par bzhed pa'i tshe bskul ba ltar shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis sbyar ba'o// //'dis kyang bstan pa rin po che phyogs kun tu dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig //sarba maṅga laṃ// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i 'khrid yig snying bo'i don bsdus pa bzhugs/ - PAGE 152-- PAGE 151-- PAGE 140-
